result:
Compiled successfully (the deprecation note is expected, since I test `getSplitTime()`, `getStartTime()`, and `getStopTime()`, which are documented as deprecated).

I wrote `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/StopWatchAgentTest.java` covering the full documented contract: construction/factories, start/stop/reset lifecycle and their `IllegalStateException` guards, suspend/resume (including the frozen-time behavior during suspension), split/unsplit (including the "continues in background" behavior and `getSplits()`), time accessors (`getTime`, `getNanoTime`, `getDuration`, `getTime(TimeUnit)`), start/stop instants and their deprecated millis equivalents, string formatting (`toString`, `toSplitString`, `formatTime`, `formatSplitTime`) with and without a message, the functional delegation methods (`get`, `run`, `getT`, `runT`) including exception propagation, and the nested `StopWatch.Split` class. `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
